payload.core_mechanism_summary: DP with state (position, last character) tracking max euphony using up to k changes. Transitions over preceding character, adding bonus for adjacent pair.
payload.rationale: The DP table dp[i][j][l] stores best score up to position i ending with letter j using exactly l changes. This is a classic 2D DP (position, last character) with an extra dimension for change count, consistent with dp_2d_state.
